headline.en: Vornado, Related's 85 10th Avenue CMBS Loan Sent to Special Servicing
headline.zh: Vornado与Related旗下85 10th Avenue的CMBS贷款被移交特殊服务

summary.en: A $396 million CMBS loan secured by 85 10th Avenue, a 633,000-square-foot Manhattan office property owned jointly by Vornado Realty Trust and the Related Companies, has been sent to special servicing due to imminent maturity default, per a Morningstar Credit alert. The loan makes up DBWF 2016-85T and is part of the CD 2017-CD3 and BACM 2017-BNK3 conduits; Morningstar said the transfer appears aimed at getting ahead of the loan's December 2026 maturity date.
summary.zh: 据Morningstar Credit的提示，由Vornado Realty Trust与Related Companies共同拥有的曼哈顿63.3万平方英尺写字楼85 10th Avenue所担保的3.96亿美元CMBS贷款，因即将到期违约而被移交特殊服务。该贷款构成DBWF 2016-85T，并属于规模更大的CD 2017-CD3和BACM 2017-BNK3通道；Morningstar表示，此次移交似乎意在提前应对该贷款2026年12月的到期日。

headline.en: Aperture expands litigation credit platform beyond $600m
headline.zh: Aperture 将诉讼信贷平台扩大至逾 6 亿美元

summary.en: Alternative asset manager Aperture Investors has expanded its litigation-focused private credit platform to more than $600m in assets under management. The move gives the Litigation Finance Private Credit platform approximately $1bn in total investment capacity.
summary.zh: 另类资产管理公司 Aperture Investors 已将其专注诉讼的私募信贷平台扩大至管理资产超过 6 亿美元。此举使该 Litigation Finance Private Credit 平台拥有约 10 亿美元的总投资能力。
